spine.purpose: Era volumes on the Eras shelf and every other sub-era block on the Binges timeline. Same value as Yearbook Navy by day; split out so the night edition can keep spines dark.

spine-2.purpose: Alternate sub-era blocks on the Binges timeline so neighbours read apart.

night-spine.purpose: Spine on night pages, a step lighter than Night Page so volumes stay visible.

night-spine-2.purpose: Alternate sub-era blocks on night pages.

year-numeral.purpose: Giant year opening each spread, aria-hidden.

headline.purpose: Page titles; hero pages up to clamp(40px, 5.5vw, 72px).

slab-label.purpose: Superlative names, column heads, year labels; spine titles on the Eras shelf (20px, 17px for long names) and sub-era names under the Binges timeline (16px) use the same slab.

lede.purpose: One-sentence finding under a heading, max 68ch.

caption.purpose: Portrait and cover captions, artist lines, table headers, legends.

now-playing.purpose: Status line under the playing item, Gold Ink.

shadows.name: lift

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Music Yearbook"**

The site is printed like a school yearbook: bright white paper, two school colors, near-black ink. Each year is a spread. A giant navy year numeral and a strict grid of artist portraits sit on the left, a thick gold gutter divides the page, and the right column lists the year's superlatives, each one a large square cover with a gold-edged slab label and the song title set big. Album covers and artist photos carry most of the color; navy and gold are the school colors that frame them.

Density is generous and calm. Sections breathe on a 96px chapter rhythm, type is large (18px body), and nothing is boxed. Separation comes from space, from portraits sitting in their grid, and from gold rules. Depth appears only when something is picked up: a cover lifts on hover, a playing song lifts and wears a gold ring with a slab "Now playing" line under it. Motion steps into place and stops; nothing drifts.

The world rejects the streaming-app default: no Wrapped-style gradients, no black-and-green app look, no dashboard stat tiles, no cards or bordered boxes.
keyCharacteristics: White yearbook paper with navy fields and headings and gold rules and labels.
Collegiate slab (Alfa Slab One) for years, headings and superlative labels; Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for everything read.
Portraits in 4:5, covers in 1:1, both square-cornered and unframed, captioned underneath.
Gold rules are the only lines: a 6px gutter, 6px section rules, 2px superlative dividers, 3px underlines for the current tab.
A navy night edition (not black) for dark mode, with gold kept unchanged.

rules.name: The Two School Colors Rule
rules.body: Navy and gold are the only chrome colors. Any other color on the page comes from album art, a photo, or a chart series that names one kind of listening.

rules.name: The Gold Is a Line Rule
rules.body: Gold draws rules, underlines, rings and small fills. Text that must be read in gold uses Gold Ink, never School Gold on white.

rules.name: The Night Edition Rule
rules.body: Dark mode is navy paper (night-page), never black, and never paired with green. Gold does not change between editions.

rules.name: The Shade Carries Data Rule
rules.body: Light-to-dark shading appears only where it encodes a quantity (heatmaps, era lines). Nowhere else are colors faded or tinted.

rules.name: The Slab Stamps, Sans Speaks Rule
rules.body: Slab is for years, headings, rank numbers and superlative labels. Sentences, captions and controls are always in Atkinson Hyperlegible Next.

rules.name: The Numbers Line Up Rule
rules.body: Years, ranks, hours and table figures use tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Picked Up Rule
rules.body: Shadows appear only when something is lifted by the visitor or floats above the page. Nothing sits in a raised panel at rest.

rules.name: The No Box Rule
rules.body: No element is enclosed on all four sides by a border. Separation is space, a grid, or a single gold rule.

dos: Do open each year as a spread: slab year numeral, 4:5 portrait grid, 6px gold gutter, superlatives column.
Do let album covers and artist photos carry the color, framed by navy and gold.
Do separate with space and single gold rules (2px between rows, 3px for active underlines, 6px between major parts).
Do use the Lift shadow only for hover, the playing item, and floating layers.
Do move with cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1) at 150ms to 350ms, and drop all motion under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do keep every corner square except the round play controls and toggle.
Do use Gold Ink, not School Gold, for any gold text on white.
donts: Don't use gradients as color (the only linear-gradient is a solid gold bar drawn under page titles).
Don't build a black-and-green app look; the night edition is navy.
Don't make dashboard stat tiles; numbers go in sentences, captions and right-aligned list values.
Don't enclose content in cards or four-sided bordered boxes.
Don't add pills, tags or chips; pickers are plain words with a gold underline.
Don't set sentences, captions or controls in the slab, or track the slab.
Don't introduce a third chrome color; extra hues are reserved for chart series that each name one kind of listening.
